d: Prakritik sansadhnon se sanpann rajy jharkhand men kainsar ke rogiyon ki sankhya teji se barhi hai. rajy ka apna koee kainsar rajistar nahin hone ki vajah se koee nishchit aankra svasthy vibhag ke pas uplabdh nahin hai. lekin tata kainsar phaundeshan, rims, hajaribag dental kolej hospital aur aaeesiemaaar-ensiaarpi ke neshnal deta ke aadhar par rajy ke ensidi yani non kamyunikebal dijij kantrol program ke stet nodal adhikari do. ravi raj batate hain ki jharkhand men har ek lakh logon men karib 70 log kisi na kisi tarah ke kainsar se grast hain.
